name: cloud-native-security-offensive
description: Use when the user asks about AWS privilege escalation paths, cloud attack paths, IMDS SSRF, iam:PassRole abuse, Azure managed identity abuse, or a cloud threat model for an authorized review. Explains each path with its detection and remediation. Not for building guardrails (use cloud-native-security-defensive) or general pentest method (use red-team-pentest-methodology).
